title: Bug report without access to the code: ask, plan, do not guess

expect.check: States no root cause, because no code was read; anything offered is labelled a hypothesis.
Says what it needs to reproduce: the repository, the reported version, steps or logs.
Plans to reproduce on the reported version AND on the latest default branch.
Says that if the bug is gone on the default branch it will find the fixing commit and stop.
Makes no code change and proposes no patch.
